map.IVF 受精率/着床率统计器 使用指南: IVF Fertilization / Implantation Rate Statistics Tool User Guide
map.输入获卵数、受精数、卵裂数、可移植胚胎数、移植数与临床妊娠数，工具逐项计算受精率: Enter oocytes retrieved, fertilized, cleaved, transferable embryos, transfers and clinical pregnancies, and the tool computes fertilization rate, cleavage rate, good embryo rate, implantation rate and pregnancy rate item by item, for IVF cycle outcome statistics and laboratory quality control.
map.受精率 = 受精数 / 获卵数 × 100%: Fertilization rate = fertilized oocytes / oocytes retrieved × 100%
map.受精/卵裂/优质/着床率测算。: Compute fertilization / cleavage / good-quality / implantation rates.
map.质控与改进依据。: Basis for quality control and improvement.
map.卵 12/MII 10/受精 8/卵裂 8/优质 5/可用 5/移植 2/囊胚: Oocytes 12 / MII 10 / fertilized 8 / cleaved 8 / good quality 5 / usable 5 / transferred 2 / blastocysts 1
map.：受精率 8/12=66.7%、正常受精 8/10=80%、卵裂 100%、优质: : fertilization rate 8/12 = 66.7%, normal fertilization 8/10 = 80%, cleavage 100%, good quality 5/8 = 62.5%, implantation 1/2 = 50%, so the laboratory stage meets targets.
map.：受精率<60% 提示受精障碍，可改 ICSI 或评估精液。: : a fertilization rate below 60% suggests a fertilization disorder; switch to ICSI or assess the semen.
map.受精率/卵裂率/优质率分母取受精卵数；正常受精率分母为 MII 数；着床率分母为: Fertilization, cleavage and good-quality rates use fertilized oocytes as the denominator; normal fertilization uses the MII count; implantation rate uses the number of transfers.
map.受精率≥60%、着床率≥30% 常作质控参考。: A fertilization rate of at least 60% and an implantation rate of at least 30% are common quality-control references.
